_meta.purpose: Courier / fetch errands for the v26 narration overhaul. An NPC in `fromCity` asks the player to deliver an item to `toCity` (kind:'deliver') or recover a dropped item on `route` and return it at `toCity` (kind:'recover'). Mirrored by DEFAULT_STORY_ERRANDS in battle.html (offline fallback). Reward sizes are MAINTAINER-OWNED balance numbers — tune freely. reward can be { gold }, { ultra } (Ultra Balls), or { item:{id,count} }.

offerLines: The foreman wipes his thumb clean before he hands you the ledger.
“See the Move Tutor in the next town? Give them this. It’s the night shift list. Their lessons got moved.”
deliverLines: The tutor breaks the seal. “The whole shift. Good. I can get them in before the bell.” They count out your pay on the counter.
errands.townLine: “The quarry crew came for their lessons before the bell. One of them asked if you’d be passing through again.”

offerLines: A student comes running with his bag open. “My sister’s studying by the lake. I took her notes by mistake. Could you drop them off?”
deliverLines: His sister finds the map under a page of sums. “So that’s where it went.” She lifts her bookmark and takes out the bills she’d been using to hold her place.
errands.townLine: “The student by the lake got the route map right. I know because she drew it for me on a napkin. Twice.”

offerLines: The Safari warden slips a thumb through the empty loop on her belt.
“I lost a canvas pouch near the boardwalk. My name’s inside. If you find it, I’ll be at the ranger station.”
recoverLines: A strap is caught under the boardwalk. You rub mud off the pouch until the warden’s name shows through.
deliverLines: The warden fishes out the spare key. “They’ve been waiting at the gate in wet boots.” She presses an Ultra Ball into your hand on her way out.
errands.townLine: “They finished the count before dark, thanks to that key. The warden put her pouch on a shorter strap.”
